name.description: Required. The name (project, location, cluster) of the cluster to update. Specified in the format `projects/*/locations/*/clusters/*`.

update.description: Required. A description of the update represented as a string using JSON format. The full update request object can be found at https://cloud.google.com/container-engine/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.clusters/update https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/reference/rest/v1/ClusterUpdate
